title: 第136章 混沌剧毒
slug: 我在战锤抽词条帝皇站起来了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

废船坑底，卡班哈举起巨大的黄铜斧，加快脚步，满意地从坑底走了上来。

它感觉到原体到场了。

帝国摄政来了，那它走上来的这个行为也不是特别丢脸，不算以大欺小。

“你可认得我是谁？奥特拉玛的摄政王。我乃恐虐大将卡班哈，承蒙我主之愤恨，你我乃是天生仇敌！！！”

巨大的蝠翼红皮恶魔从坑底出现。

它每踏一步地面就炸开一道蛛网状的裂缝。

岩浆从它脚底喷涌而出，四散奔流。

是的，就是这样。

它堂堂恐虐大魔，受血神宠爱的黄铜王座之下最凶猛的战将，当然不是随随便便就被一群拿着发光爆弹枪的杂兵逼出来的。

它是感应到了人类帝国原体的降临才亲自迎战。

同级对手，原体对大魔，这才是符合它身份的对阵。

屠夫之刃的锋刃上寒光逼人，斧柄上缠着的颅骨锁链叮当作响。

恐虐大魔最后一步跨出了撞击坑的边缘，黄铜巨躯从废船残骸的阴影中完全脱离，暴露在普兰迪姆的日光之下。

卡班哈将屠夫之刃遥遥对准了基里曼。

燃烧着火焰的巨眼锁定着帝国摄政，咧开嘴角，露出黄铜色的獠牙，然后发出一声咆哮挑衅：“你的孩子们将会用来装点我王的王座——！！！”

咆哮声化作有形的震荡冲击波，地面的碎石被音波掀飞，远处的极限战士在冲击波下晃了晃。

来啊，帝国摄政。看看一万年后你还有多少斤两。

基里曼回应了。

基里曼横起帝皇之剑，剑尖指向卡班哈。

缠绕在剑身上的永恒火焰从剑尖向上蔓延，把那整柄巨剑烧成了一根直指恶魔的火炬。

然后他用帝皇之剑对准卡班哈的翅膀，做了一个砍掉的动作。

卡班哈曾经多次被圣吉列斯撕掉翅膀，对这个动作简直有了心理阴影，看到就条件反射暴跳如雷。

宣战吗？恶魔。

两方挑衅完毕，没有多余的废话，同时动了。

两百步的距离对两个巨型生物来说不过是一瞬间的事。

卡班哈的蝠翼猛地向后扇动，粗壮双腿蹬地助推他庞大的身躯以完全不符合体型的爆发速度向前弹射。

基里曼同时启动，精金战靴踏碎脚下的岩壳，帝皇之剑的火焰随着他在空中画出一道耀眼的轨迹。

两个巨人撞在一起。

整个普兰迪姆的地面像被端起颠了一下。

地面震出一道圆形的塌陷区，灰尘和碎石被推成一道环形的浪潮向四面八方扩散。

Page (1/3)

At the bottom of the hulk pit, Kabanha raised the huge brass ax, quickened his pace, and walked up from the bottom of the pit with satisfaction.

It sensed the Primarch's presence.

The Imperial Regent is here, so what he did is not particularly embarrassing, nor does it count as bullying the small.

"Do you know who I am? The regent of Ultramar. I am Ka'banhar, the great general of Khorne. Thanks to the wrath of my lord, you and I are natural enemies!!!"

A huge bat-winged red-skinned demon emerged from the bottom of the pit.

Every time it took a step, a spiderweb-shaped crack exploded in the ground.

Magma spurted out from the bottom of its feet and flowed in all directions.

Yes, that's it.

It was the mighty Daemon of Khorne, the most ferocious warrior under the Brazen Throne favored by the Blood God. Of course, he was not just forced out by a group of soldiers armed with glowing bolters.

It sensed the arrival of the Primarch of the Human Empire and fought against it personally.

Opponents of the same level, the original body versus the big demon, this is the match that suits its status.

The sharp edge of the Butcher's Blade cast a cold light, and the skull chains wrapped around the ax handle jingled.

The Great Daemon of Khorne took the last step over the edge of the impact crater, and the giant brass body completely escaped from the shadow of the wreckage of the hulk, exposed to the sunlight of Plandim.

Kabanha aimed the Butcher's Blade at Guilliman from a distance.

The huge eyes burning with fire locked on the Imperial Regent, grinned, revealing the brass fangs, and then let out a roar of provocation: "Your children will be used to decorate my king's throne-!!!"

The roar turned into a tangible shock wave, and the gravel on the ground was blown away by the sound wave. The Ultramarines in the distance swayed under the shock wave.

Come, Imperial Regent.See how much you still have in ten thousand years.

Guilliman responded.

Guilliman raised the Emperor's Sword, pointing the tip at Ka'banha.

The eternal flame wrapped around the sword spread upwards from the tip, burning the entire giant sword into a torch pointed directly at the devil.

Then he aimed the Emperor's Sword at Kabanha's wings and made a cutting motion.

Kabanha had his wings torn off by Sanguinius many times, and he had a psychological shadow on this action. When he saw it, he would become furious upon seeing it.

Declare war?demon.

After the provocation was completed, the two parties moved at the same time without any unnecessary nonsense.

The distance of two hundred steps is only a matter of seconds for the two giant creatures.

Kabanha's bat wings suddenly flapped backwards, and his thick legs kicked off the ground to help his huge body eject forward at an explosive speed that was completely inconsistent with his size.

Guilliman activated at the same time, his adamantine boots crushed the rock crust beneath his feet, and the flames of the Emperor's Sword followed him in a dazzling trajectory in the air.

Two giants collide.

The entire ground of Plandim seemed to be shaken up.

A circular collapse area was created on the ground, and dust and gravel were pushed into a circular wave that spread in all directions.
